coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Fifteen attacks ran and none landed. Turn-2 custody held at c609de64 / 0444, the frozen turn-1 subject held at 46993d47 / 0444, HEAD remained f5094f0, and all eleven measured inputs reproduce, including both turn-1 verdicts. The recital is exact: Claude objected only on CLAUDE-D138-SF1 at SHOULD-FIX grade and Codex consented at 0/0. The repair is fully landed. The inaccurate imported statement that most classes are candidate-owned is gone; Decision 2 now says what v2's bytes support: NT-1 through NT-8 are specified but unexecuted, none is named by a DR-G obligation, none has an assigned owner, and the artifact assigns no owners to those classes. Each negative-test object has exactly name, input, and pass fields, with zero owner or existingGate fields, and the live DR-G table names none of their test names. The eligibility conclusion remains sound: fixture/harness authoring still precedes execution, so gate 2 is not established, while absent exact DR-G ownership fails gate 3; gate 1 independently fails because v2 remains a non-applied, non-sealed candidate binding nothing. The prior apparatus advisory is correctly venued outside the subject and not claimed as performed. No unrelated operative bytes moved: the stale-cell MF-6, advisory roster, non-SATISFIED standing, zero readiness effect, and temporal reversibility all remain intact. DR-131 stays OPEN, Class A remains closed, file 08 stays untouched at 4 of 32, and no implementation or D-096 authority appears.
